notes: The public-API scenario exercises IEEE 1516.1-2025 §4.12 resignation and §4.12.4 ownership-assumption continuation after a known candidate becomes eligible by publishing later. The candidate discovers the owner's object while subscribed but not publishing. The owner resigns with UNCONDITIONALLY_DIVEST_ATTRIBUTES; no assumption callback is yet delivered. Publishing the attribute then produces Request Attribute Ownership Assumption for the object, attribute and HLAprivilegeToDeleteObject, with an empty tag. Direct pinned mappings are page-058-l112-33 -> §4.12 and page-059-l8-1 -> §4.12.4. The adapter supplies provider, endpoint, FOM, names, callback model, and logical-time implementation. Current-source installed-package C++ primary/contract passed 4/4 under evoked and immediate callbacks; Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR but has no provider-runtime evidence. This does not claim later-join continuation, terminal re-search, or conformance.
